description: A labelled row of filter controls above what they narrow, with the filters in effect as removable chips and a Clear all control. The bar holds no filter state: the host passes the controls, writes `applied` and answers each removal. Removing a chip keeps focus in the bar. The bar stacks by its own width, never by the viewport's, and stacking reorders nothing.

label.description: Names the group of filters, such as "Deployment filters", never "Filters". Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: a group with no name announces only that a group began.

content.description: The filter controls, in order: selects, inputs, segmented controls, comboboxes. Fills the bar's control row and never replaces the bar. Required, and guarded at runtime: a bar with no control filters nothing.

applied.description: The filters in effect, drawn as chips in a list after the controls. An empty list draws no chip row.

clearable.description: Whether Clear all is drawn while `applied` holds a filter. Every layer gates on this member and never on whether anything listens for `clear`.

remove.description: A chip's remove button was activated; carries the whole filter. Once the host drops it from `applied`, focus moves to the chip now in its place, else the last chip, else the first control. A control the person has moved to since keeps focus.

clear.description: Clear all was activated. Once the host empties `applied`, focus moves to the first control.
